# 2 bedroom flat for sale

> A beautifully presented first floor 2 bedroom apartment situated on the popular London Road, Canterbury. With its spacious rooms, residential parking, close proximity to schools, Canterbury City Centre, Canterbury West train station, and nearby links to the A2. This property provides an ideal residence for those who work in or out of the city walls or require high speed access to London via HS1.
